scrape_api_docs: scrape API documentation from HTML content and extract function signatures with parameters
extract_parameters: extract parameter names and defaults from a Python function signature string
format_documentation: format a list of extracted API documentation dictionaries into a readable string
run_scraper: run the web scraper on sample HTML to extract and print API documentation
review_scrape_api_docs: review the scrape_api_docs function to improve HTML parsing for documentation extraction
